text: I withdraw this problem vote after the [reply](https://github.com/CBirkbeck/tauceti-reviewed-by-test/issues/162). The [class](https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/2cabef97b63d3275776b8b060d802de6a6fa1055/Mathlib/Algebra/GroupWithZero/Action/Defs.lean#L185) expresses the intended action on a set A with a distinguished zero: 1 acts identically, (r*s) • a = r • (s • a), r • 0 = 0, and 0 • a = 0. Multiplication belongs to the scalar monoid; A needs no multiplication. The docstring is imprecise on that point, but the definition has no mathematical defect.
